name: etherpad-apb
description: Provisions a collaborative real-time note-taking application (Etherpad Lite) backed by MariaDB, including two deployments, two services, a route, and two persistent volume claims.

name: hastebin-apb
description: Provisions the Hastebin pastebin web application with a Memcached sidecar container, a ConfigMap-mounted config, a service, and a route.

name: mediawiki123-apb
description: Provisions a MediaWiki 1.23 wiki application using a route-first pattern to inject the hostname as an environment variable, along with a persistent volume claim and a service.

name: nginx-oss-apb
description: Provisions an NGINX Open Source reverse proxy and load balancer with a dynamically generated configuration from a Jinja2 template mounted as a ConfigMap, a service, and a route.

name: pyzip-demo-apb
description: Provisions a minimal stateless Python ZIP code lookup demo web application with a single deployment, a service, and a route.

name: pyzip-demo-db-apb
description: Provisions a PostGIS-enabled PostgreSQL database pre-seeded with geospatial data for use with the pyzip-demo application, including a persistent volume claim, a service, and bind credential exposure.
